lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Approximately five horizontal rows of high-luminance circular clusters arranged in a grid-like pattern posterior to the pectoral fin insertion.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with the horizontal rows of spots, forming distinct anchor nodes across the mid-lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three prominent longitudinal ridges are visible on the upper half of the flank, characterized by a sharp luminance gradient with a highlight on the dorsal edge and a shadow on the ventral edge.

other_distinctive_markers: A dense concentration of high-luminance micro-pixels is present on the cranial region, transitioning into larger, more spatially separated spots on the trunk.
